name: gizza-ai/json-escape
summary: Escape or unescape a string for JSON

tool.description: Escape or unescape special characters in a string for safe use inside JSON. mode=escape (default) turns raw text into a JSON-safe string body (escaping quotes, backslashes, newlines, tabs, and control chars as \uXXXX); set quotes=true to also wrap it in double quotes. mode=unescape reverses it, accepting input with or without surrounding quotes. Uses a spec-correct JSON codec. Runs locally.

text.description: The string to escape or unescape.

mode.description: escape = make the text safe inside a JSON string; unescape = turn a JSON-escaped string back to raw text.

quotes.description: Escape mode only: also wrap the result in surrounding double quotes.
